# Functions
```{r functions, include = FALSE}
## --- convert power in uV^2 to dB ---
uV2_to_dB <- function(uV2){
  dB <- 10*log10(uV2)
}

## --- outlier detection of lmer models ---
outlier_modelresiduals <- function(df, model_residuals, var2clean){
  # z-score residuals
  residuals_z <- scale(model_residuals)[,1]
  # new column name
  newcolname <- paste0(var2clean,"_clean")
  # outlier variables to NA
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      !!newcolname := if_else(
        abs(residuals_z)>2 | is.na(residuals_z),
        NA,
        .data[[var2clean]])
    )
  # remove outlier rows
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(newcolname)))
  return(df)
}

## --- rename only the non-merge columns ---
rename_data_cols <- function(df, suffix) {
  data_cols <- setdiff(names(df), merge_cols)
  names(df)[names(df) %in% data_cols] <- paste0(data_cols, "_", suffix)
  df
}

## --- predict model estimated means ---
model_prediction <- function(model, predictVar, 
                             groupVar = NULL, 
                             facetVar = NULL, 
                             panelVar = NULL,
                             cleandf) {
  # set main grid of predictor variables
  predict_grid <- seq(min(cleandf[[predictVar]], na.rm = TRUE),
                      max(cleandf[[predictVar]], na.rm = TRUE),
                      length.out = 100)
  
  # start building the "at" list and the right hand side (rhs)
  # terms with just predictVar
  at_list   <- setNames(list(predict_grid), predictVar)
  rhs_terms <- predictVar   # terms that go with "*" (varied together)
  cond_terms <- character(0) # terms that go with "|" (conditioning/faceting)
  
  # function to get levels for a categorical/faceting variable
  get_levels <- function(varname) {
    levels(as.factor(cleandf[[varname]]))
  }
  
  # function to get levels for a moderator (group) variable, 
  # numeric -> mean +/- sd
  get_group_levels <- function(varname) {
    mod_col <- cleandf[[varname]]
    if (is.factor(mod_col) || is.character(mod_col)) {
      levels(as.factor(mod_col))
    } else {
      m <- mean(mod_col, na.rm = TRUE)
      s <- sd(mod_col,   na.rm = TRUE)
      c(m - s, m, m + s)
    }
  }
  
  # groupVar: varied alongside predictVar (interaction term)
  if (!is.null(groupVar)) {
    at_list[[groupVar]] <- get_group_levels(groupVar)
    rhs_terms <- c(rhs_terms, groupVar)
  }
  
  # facetVar: conditioning variable
  if (!is.null(facetVar)) {
    at_list[[facetVar]] <- get_levels(facetVar)
    cond_terms <- c(cond_terms, facetVar)
  }
  
  # panelVar: another conditioning variable
  if (!is.null(panelVar)) {
    at_list[[panelVar]] <- get_levels(panelVar)
    cond_terms <- c(cond_terms, panelVar)
  }
  
  # build formula: predictVar (* groupVar) (| facetVar | panelVar)
  rhs <- paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " * ")
  if (length(cond_terms) > 0) {
    rhs <- paste(rhs, paste(cond_terms, collapse = " | "), sep = " | ")
  }
  fmla <- as.formula(paste("~", rhs))
  
  emm    <- emmeans(model, fmla, at = at_list)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  
  return(emm_df)
}

# compile results into one large data frame
compile_coefs <- function(files){
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(names(files), function(nm){
      df <- files[[nm]]$coefs
      df$term <- rownames(df)
      df$model <- nm
      rownames(df) <- NULL
      df
    })
  )
}
```

# Figure settings
```{r figure settings, include=FALSE}
# overall theme
paper_theme <- theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.text = element_text(size=6),
    axis.title = element_text(size=7),
    plot.title = element_text(size=7),
    plot.margin = margin(0.5, 1, 0.5, 1, unit='mm'),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                   color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    plot.tag = element_text(size=6,face='bold'),
    legend.position = 'none',
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6)
  )

# plot_annotation theme
annot_theme <- theme(plot.background = element_rect(color=NA,fill='transparent'),
                     panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                    color=NA),
                     strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',
                                    color=NA))

  alpha_marker = 0.25,
  alpha_ribbon = 0.3,
```

# Age distribution
```{r}
# load in data
main_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/broadband_sponevo_frow_20260508.csv')
main_df <- main_df %>%
  mutate(
    eeg_age_viable = ifelse(Viable==1,
                            eeg_age,
                            NA)
  )
main_df <- main_df %>% filter(!is.na(eeg_date))
main_df <- main_df %>% filter(!is.na(Viable))

# --- Histogram ---
age_hist <- ggplot(data = main_df)+
  geom_histogram(aes(x=eeg_age), binwidth = 2,
                 alpha=0.25, color = 'black',fill = 'black') +
  geom_histogram(aes(x=eeg_age_viable),binwidth = 2,
                 alpha = 0.25, color = "#AD3DCC", fill = "#AD3DCC" )+
  scale_x_continuous(expand= c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Age (yrs)") + ylab("Count")+
  paper_theme

# --- Waterfall plot ---
# After exclusion 
d <- data.frame(age = main_df$eeg_age_viable, id=main_df$lunaid, Sex = as.factor(main_df$sex))
d_viable <- d %>% filter(!is.na(age))
waterfall_df <- d_viable %>%
  dplyr::select(id,age) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(minage = min(age)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(age_id = rank(minage, ties.method = "first")) %>%
  inner_join(d,by="id")
waterfall_df_viable <- waterfall_df %>% filter(!is.na(age))
  
eeg_waterfall_viable <- ggplot(data = waterfall_df, aes(x=age, y = age_id, color = Sex))+
  geom_point(shape = markers_list$marker_shape, size = markers_list$marker_size)+
  geom_line(aes(group=id), linewidth = lines_list$lunaid_size)+
  scale_color_manual(name = "",values = c("#3DA3CC","#CC663D"),
                                   labels = c("Female","Male")) + 
  paper_theme + xlab("Age (yrs)") + ylab("")

# Together
aligned_plts <- align_plots(
  plotlist = list(age_hist, eeg_waterfall_viable),
  axis = 'tb', align = 'h'
)
cowplot::plot_grid(aligned_plts[[1]],
                   aligned_plts[[2]],
                   nrow=1,
                   labels = c("A","B"),
                   label_size = 6)
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"age_dist.png"),
       dpi = 600, height = 50, width = 100, units = 'mm', bg = 'transparent')
```

## Age * Sex
```{r behavior plots, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "_AgeSex_Effects.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

files <- lapply(filepaths, readRDS)

names(files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filepaths))

# compile all results into one data frame
behav_agesex_coefs <- compile_coefs(files)
# adjust p-values
behav_agesex_coefs <- behav_agesex_coefs%>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

# save coefs as table
write.table(behav_agesex_coefs, file = "/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/paperfigs/tables/SM_behav_agesex_coefs.csv",
            col.names = T, row.names = F)

behavior_plot <- function(modellist,colorslist,
                           markerslist, alphalist,
                           lineslist, figtheme,
                           labelslist){
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 predictVar = "invage",
                                 groupVar = "sex",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- 1/predict_df$invage
  modellist$cleandata$eeg_age <- 1/modellist$cleandata$invage
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_point(data = modellist$cleandata,
               aes(x=eeg_age, y=behav, color = sex),
               shape = markerslist$marker_shape,
               alpha = alphalist$alpha_marker,
               size = markerslist$marker_size) + 
    geom_line(data = modellist$cleandata,
              aes(x = eeg_age, y=behav,
                  group = lunaid_clean, color = sex),
              linewidth = lineslist$lunaid_size,
              alpha = alphalist$alpha_lunaid)+
    geom_line(data= predict_df,
              aes(x=eeg_age, y=emmean, color = sex),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size
              )+
    scale_color_manual(name = "",values = c("#3DA3CC","#CC663D"),
                                   labels = c("Female","Male")) + 
    xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    figtheme
  return(plt)
}

### --- Full behavior (age*sex) figure ---

cowplot::plot_grid(
```

```{r}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "_AgeRow_Effects.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

files <- lapply(filepaths, readRDS)
names(files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filepaths))

# compile all results into one data frame
sponevo_agerow_coefs <- compile_coefs(files)
# adjust p-values
sponevo_agerow_coefs <- sponevo_agerow_coefs %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

# save coefs as table
write.table(sponevo_agerow_coefs, file = "/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/paperfigs/tables/SM_sponevo_agerow_coefs.csv",
            col.names=T, row.names = F)

sponevo_agerow_effect_plot <- function(modellist,
                                       colorslist,
                                       powertype,
                                       condition,
                                       markerslist,
                                       alphalist,
                                       lineslist, figtheme,
                                       labelslist){
  # figure colors
  if(powertype == "spon"){
    VALUES <- c("AS" = colorslist$spon,
                "VGS" = colorslist$vgs)
  } else if (powertype == "evo"){
    VALUES <- c("AS" = colorslist$evo,
                "VGS" = colorslist$vgs)
  }
  
  if (condition == "VGS"){
    COLOR <- colorslist$vgs
  } else if (condition == "AS"){
    COLOR <- colorslist[[powertype]]
  }

  # predict model
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 groupVar = "row",
                                 predictVar = "invage",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- 1/predict_df$invage
  modellist$cleandata$eeg_age <- 1/modellist$cleandata$invage
  
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_line(data = predict_df, 
              aes(x=eeg_age, y=emmean,
                  linetype = row),
              color = COLOR,
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    # scale_color_manual(name = "Condition",
    #                    values = VALUES)+
    # facet_wrap(~sex, labeller = labeller(sex = c("F" = "Females",
    #                                              "M" = "Males")))+
    xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel) +
    figtheme
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r}
                                 groupVar = "sex",
                                 predictVar = "invage",
                                 cleandf = frow_modellist$cleandata)
  frow_predict_df$eeg_age <- 1/frow_predict_df$invage

  agesex_plt <- ggplot() + 
    # P-row

    #               group = lunaid_clean),
    #           linewidth = lineslist$lunaid_size,

    # geom_line(data= prow_predict_df,
    #           aes(x=eeg_age, y=emmean, color = sex),
    #           linewidth = lineslist$line_size,
    #           linetype = 'dashed'
    #           )+
    # scale_color_manual(name = "Sex", values = VALUES,
    #                    labels = LABELS)+
    # new_scale_color()+

    geom_point(data = frow_modellist$cleandata,

    xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f",x))+
    figtheme
  
  return(agesex_plt)
}
```

```{r}
)

VGS_files <- lapply(VGS_filepaths, readRDS)

sponevo_behav_combined_plot <- function(ASmodellistfrow,
                                        ASmodellistprow,
                                        VGSmodellistfrow,
                                        VGSmodellistprow,
                                        colorslist, powertype,
                                        markerslist, alphalist,
                                        lineslist, figtheme,
                                        labelslist){
  if (powertype == "spon"){
    xlabel <- c("Spontaneous power (dB)")
  } else if (powertype == "evo"){
    xlabel <- c("Evoked power (dB)")
  }
  
  # predict responses
  ASpredict_df_frow <- model_prediction(ASmodellistfrow$model,
                                 predictVar = "power",
                                 cleandf = ASmodellistfrow$cleandata)
  VGSpredict_df_frow <- model_prediction(VGSmodellistfrow$model,
                                    predictVar = "power",
                                    cleandf = VGSmodellistfrow$cleandata)
  ASpredict_df_prow <- model_prediction(ASmodellistprow$model,
                                 predictVar = "power",
                                 cleandf = ASmodellistprow$cleandata)
  VGSpredict_df_prow <- model_prediction(VGSmodellistprow$model,
                                    predictVar = "power",
                                    cleandf = VGSmodellistprow$cleandata)
  
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    # VGS lines
    # p-row
    geom_line(data = VGSpredict_df_prow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist$vgs,
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size,
              linetype = "dashed")+
    # f-row
    geom_line(data = VGSpredict_df_frow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist$vgs,
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    # AS lines
    # p-row
    geom_line(data = ASpredict_df_prow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist[[powertype]],
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size,
              linetype = "dashed")+
    # f-row
    geom_line(data = ASpredict_df_frow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist[[powertype]],
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    figtheme + xlab(xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r}
# load in matlab data
corAS.ids_list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/corAS_data/prep/corAS_prep_avgtrl_ids.mat")
VGS.ids_list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/VGS_data/prep/VGS_prep_avgtrl_ids.mat")

clustermasks <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/Cluster_stats/corASvsVGS_tfceresults_ersp_prep_avgtrl_prow.mat")

# unlist variables
times <- as.numeric(clusterstats[["times"]])
freqs <- as.numeric(clusterstats[["freqs"]])
t_age <- clusterstats[["tval"]][[2]]
t_condition <- clusterstats[["tval"]][[3]]
t_interaction <- clusterstats[["tval"]][[4]]
mask_interaction <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[3]][[3]]
mask_age <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[1]][[3]]
mask_condition <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[2]][[3]]

enhancedt_age <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[1]][[2]]
enhancedt_condition <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[2]][[2]]

# plot t-values and masks from tfce
# interaction
t_interaction_df <- melt(t_interaction)
colnames(t_interaction_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
t_interaction_df$time <- times[t_interaction_df$time_idx]
t_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[t_interaction_df$freq_idx]
mask_interaction_df <- melt(mask_interaction)
colnames(mask_interaction_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
mask_interaction_df$time <- times[mask_interaction_df$time_idx]
mask_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[mask_interaction_df$freq_idx]
mask_interaction_df$value <- as.factor(mask_interaction_df$value)
enhancedt_interaction_df <- melt(enhancedt_interaction)
colnames(enhancedt_interaction_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
enhancedt_interaction_df$time <- times[enhancedt_interaction_df$time_idx]
enhancedt_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[enhancedt_interaction_df$freq_idx]
# age
t_age_df <- melt(t_age)
colnames(t_age_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
t_age_df$time <- times[t_age_df$time_idx]
t_age_df$freq <- freqs[t_age_df$freq_idx]
mask_age_df <- melt(mask_age)
colnames(mask_age_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
mask_age_df$time <- times[mask_age_df$time_idx]
mask_age_df$freq <- freqs[mask_age_df$freq_idx]
mask_age_df$value <- as.factor(mask_age_df$value)
enhancedt_age_df <- melt(enhancedt_age)
colnames(enhancedt_age_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
enhancedt_age_df$time <- times[enhancedt_age_df$time_idx]
enhancedt_age_df$freq <- freqs[enhancedt_age_df$freq_idx]
# condition
t_condition_df <- melt(t_condition)
colnames(t_condition_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
t_condition_df$time <- times[t_condition_df$time_idx]
t_condition_df$freq <- freqs[t_condition_df$freq_idx]
mask_condition_df <- melt(mask_condition)
colnames(mask_condition_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
mask_condition_df$time <- times[mask_condition_df$time_idx]
mask_condition_df$freq <- freqs[mask_condition_df$freq_idx]
mask_condition_df$value <- as.factor(mask_condition_df$value)
enhancedt_condition_df <- melt(enhancedt_condition)
colnames(enhancedt_condition_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
enhancedt_condition_df$time <- times[enhancedt_condition_df$time_idx]
enhancedt_condition_df$freq <- freqs[enhancedt_condition_df$freq_idx]
# round grids to same precision
t_interaction_df$time <- round(t_interaction_df$time, 4)
mask_interaction_df$time <- round(mask_interaction_df$time, 4)
t_interaction_df$freq <- round(t_interaction_df$freq, 4)
mask_interaction_df$freq <- round(mask_interaction_df$freq, 4)

# compute tile sizes
time_res <- min(diff(sort(unique(t_interaction_df$time))))
freq_res <- min(diff(sort(unique(t_interaction_df$freq))))

# remove too small clusters
mask_interaction_clean_df  <- mask_interaction_df %>%
  mutate(
    value = ifelse(freq < 16, 0, as.numeric(as.character(value)))
  )
mask_interaction_clean_df$value <- factor(mask_interaction_clean_df$value, levels = c(0,1))
  
# contours around clusters
# only contour around cluster 3 and 5 and 6
mask_interaction_clust1_5_6 <- mask_interaction_clean_df %>% mutate(
  value = ifelse(freq >= 47 & freq <= 50.7 &
                   time >=0 & time<=500 & value ==1, 1,
                 ifelse(freq>=38 & freq <42.6 & time>=245 & time <=380 & value ==1,
                        2,
                        ifelse(freq >=16 & freq <=21 &
                                 time>=370 & time <= 500 & value==1,
                               3,0)))
  )
mask_interaction_clust1_5_6 <- mask_interaction_clust1_5_6 %>%
  mutate(
    clust1 = ifelse(value == 1, 1, 0),
    clust2 = ifelse(value == 2, 1, 0),
    clust3 = ifelse(value == 3, 1, 0)
  )

# adjust margins
heatmap_margin <- margin(1.75,1.75,1.75,1.75,unit='mm')

# mask of clusters
mask_interaction_fig_clust1_5_6 <- ggplot() + 
  geom_tile(data=t_interaction_df, aes(x=time,y=freq, fill=value),
            width = time_res, height = freq_res,color=NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="t-value",
                       limits = c(-4,4)) +
  guides(fill = 'none')+
  new_scale_fill()+
   geom_contour(data = mask_interaction_clust1_5_6,
               aes(x=time, y=freq,z = clust1),
               breaks = 1,
               color = colors_list$c3,
               linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_contour(data=mask_interaction_clust1_5_6 ,
               aes(x=time, y=freq,z = clust2),
               breaks = 1,
               color = colors_list$c5prow ,
               linewidth=0.5)+
  geom_contour(data=mask_interaction_clust1_5_6 ,
               aes(x=time, y=freq,z = clust3),
               breaks = 1,
               color = colors_list$c6,
               linewidth=0.5)+
  geom_raster(data = mask_interaction_clean_df, aes(x=time,y=freq,fill = value),
            alpha=0.5)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1"=NA,
                               "0" = "black"),
                    na.value = NA)+
  labs(x = "Preparatory time (ms)", y = "Frequency (Hz)") +
  guides(fill="none")+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,10,20,30,40,50,60,70),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  paper_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = heatmap_margin)

mask_interaction_fig_clust1_5_6 
ggsave("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/paperfigs/interaction_clusters3_5_6prow.png",
       dpi=700, width = 45, height = 105, units = "mm")
```

```{r}
cluster_behav_plot <- function(AS_modellist, 
                               VGS_modellist,
                               cluster,behav, colorslist,
                               markerslist, alphalist,
                               lineslist, figtheme,
                               labelslist,
                               share_yaxis = NULL){

  # --- Behavior plots ---
  # AS model predictions
  AS_predict_df <- model_prediction(model = AS_modellist$model,
                                    predictVar = paste0("corAS_",
                                                         cluster,
                                                         "_ersp_interaction_frow"),
                                     groupVar = "invage",
                                    cleandf = AS_modellist$cleandata)
  colnames(AS_predict_df) <- c("ersp","invage","emmean","SE","df",
                                "lower.CL","upper.CL")
  AS_predict_df$eeg_age <- as.factor(round(1/AS_predict_df$invage))
  # VGS model predictions
  VGS_predict_df <- model_prediction(model = VGS_modellist$model,
                                     predictVar = paste0("VGS_",
                                                         cluster,
                                                         "_ersp_interaction_frow"),
                                     groupVar = "invage",
                                     cleandf = VGS_modellist$cleandata)
  colnames(VGS_predict_df) <- c("ersp","invage","emmean","SE","df",
                                "lower.CL","upper.CL")
  VGS_predict_df$eeg_age <- as.factor(round(1/VGS_predict_df$invage))
  
  # determine if axes should be shared
  if (!is.null(share_yaxis)){
    if (share_yaxis == 1){
      # figure out a shared range across both predictions first
      y_min <- min(c(AS_predict_df$lower.CL, VGS_predict_df$lower.CL))
      y_max <- max(c(AS_predict_df$upper.CL, VGS_predict_df$upper.CL))
      shared_breaks <- scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5)(c(y_min, y_max))
      yaxis <- scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), breaks = shared_breaks)
      } 
    } else {
    yaxis <- scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) round(x,2))
  }
  
  # --- AS cluster colors ---
  if (cluster == "c1"){
    VALUES = c("#5B1A4B",colorslist[[cluster]],"#E5A4D5")
  } else if (cluster == "c5"){
    VALUES = c("#5B2A1A",colorslist[[cluster]],"#E5B4A4")
  }
  
  # --- AS ---
  AS_behav_plt <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, y=emmean, color = eeg_age))+
    geom_ribbon(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, ymin= lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL,
                  fill = eeg_age),
              color=NA, alpha = 0.3)+ ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    scale_color_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                       values = VALUES)+
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                      values =VALUES)+
    yaxis +
    xlab("AS ERSP (dB)")+
    figtheme 

  # --- VGS ---
  VGS_behav_plt <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(data = VGS_predict_df, 
              aes(x = ersp, y = emmean, color = eeg_age),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size) + 
    geom_ribbon(data = VGS_predict_df,
              aes(x = ersp, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, 
                  fill = eeg_age),
              alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                       values = c("grey20","grey50","grey80"))+
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                      values = c("grey20","grey50","grey80"))+
    ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    xlab("VGS ERSP (dB)")+
    yaxis +
    figtheme
  
  
  
  return(list(AS_plt = AS_behav_plt, 
              VGS_plt = VGS_behav_plt))
}

      grepl("ersp",term, ignore.case = T) ~ "ersp",
      .default = term
    )
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
cluster_behav_plot <- function(AS_modellist, 
                               VGS_modellist,
                               cluster,behav, colorslist,
                               markerslist, alphalist,
                               lineslist, figtheme,
                               labelslist){
  # violin plot of ERSP distribution
  AS_df <- AS_modellist$cleandata
  AS_df <- AS_df %>% mutate(
    condition = as.factor("AS"))
  AS_df <- AS_df[,c("behav","invage","sex",cluster,"lunaid_clean","condition")]
  colnames(AS_df) <-  c("behav","invage","sex","ersp","lunaid_clean","condition")
  VGS_df <- VGS_modellist$cleandata 
  VGS_df <- VGS_df %>% mutate(
    condition = as.factor("VGS"))
  VGS_df <- VGS_df[,c(behav,"invage",paste0("VGS_",cluster,"_ersp_interaction_prow"),"sex","lunaid_clean","condition")]
  VGS_df <- VGS_df[, c(behav, "invage","sex",paste0("VGS_",cluster,"_ersp_interaction_prow"),"lunaid_clean","condition")]
  colnames(VGS_df) <- c("behav","invage","sex","ersp","lunaid_clean","condition")
  long_df <- rbind(AS_df, VGS_df)
  
  violin_plt <- ggplot(data=long_df, 
                       aes(x=condition,y=ersp,color= condition))+
    geom_jitter(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.2, 
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.25,
                                                dodge.width = 0.75),
                shape = 16) + 
     stat_slab(aes(fill = condition), 
                  adjust = 0.75,
                  width = 0.6,
                  justification = -0.25,
                  color = NA,
                  alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,
                     width = 0.15, 
                     color='black',
                     fill = NA,
                     size=0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("AS" = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
                                              "VGS" = colorslist$vgsprow)) + 
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = c("AS" = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
                                              "VGS" = colorslist$vgsprow)) +
    figtheme + ylab("ERSP (dB)")+
    theme(legend.position = 'none')+
    xlab("Condition")
  
  # return(violin_plt)
  
  long_df$eeg_age <- 1/long_df$invage
  trajectory_plt <- ggplot(data = long_df, aes(x=eeg_age, y=ersp, color = condition)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.3)+
    geom_smooth(method='lm',formula = y~I(1/x),
                linewidth = lineslist$line_size,se=F)+
    scale_color_manual(name=NULL, 
                       values = c("AS" = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
                                  "VGS" = colorslist$vgsprow))+
    figtheme + xlab(labelslist$xlabel)+ ylab("ERSP (dB)")
    theme(legend.position = 'none'
          # axis.title.y = element_blank()
          )
  # return(trajectory_plt)
  
  # behavior plot
  # AS model predictions
  AS_predict_df <- model_prediction(model = AS_modellist$model,
                                    predictVar = cluster,
                                    cleandf = AS_modellist$cleandata)
  colnames(AS_predict_df) <- c("ersp","emmean","SE","df","lower.CL","upper.CL")
  
  # just AS
  AS_behav_plt <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, y=emmean),color = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]])+
    geom_ribbon(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, ymin= lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
              fill = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
              color=NA, alpha = 0.3)+ ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    figtheme + xlab("AS ERSP (dB)")
  
  return(list(dist_plt = violin_plt, traj_plt = trajectory_plt, 
         AS_plt = AS_behav_plt))
}
```

### Heat-maps
```{r}
corAS.ids_list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/corAS_data/prep/corAS_prep_avgtrl_ids.mat")
VGS.ids_list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/VGS_data/prep/VGS_prep_avgtrl_ids.mat")
corASersp.list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/corAS_data/prep/corAS_prep_avgtrl_frow_ersp.mat")
VGSersp.list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/VGS_data/prep/VGS_prep_avgtrl_frow_ersp.mat")

# unlist variables
times <- as.numeric(corASersp.list[["times"]])
freqs <- as.numeric(corASersp.list[["freqs"]])
corASersp_all <- corASersp.list[["avg.ersp"]]
VGSersp <- VGSersp.list[["avg.ersp"]]
corASids <- corAS.ids_list[["idmat"]]

# remove non-viable from AS ersp
viable_idx <- corASids[,4] == 1
corASersp <- corASersp_all[viable_idx, , ]

# average across people
avgcorASersp <- apply(corASersp, c(2,3), mean, na.rm=T)
avgVGSersp <- apply(VGSersp, c(2,3), mean, na.rm=T)

# convert to data frames for plotting
corASersp_df <- melt(avgcorASersp)
colnames(corASersp_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
corASersp_df$time <- times[corASersp_df$time_idx]
corASersp_df$freq <- freqs[corASersp_df$freq_idx]

VGSersp_df <- melt(avgVGSersp)
colnames(VGSersp_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
VGSersp_df$time <- times[VGSersp_df$time_idx]
VGSersp_df$freq <- freqs[VGSersp_df$freq_idx]

# compute tile sizes
time_res <- min(diff(sort(unique(corASersp_df$time))))
freq_res <- min(diff(sort(unique(corASersp_df$freq))))

# --- Raw ERSP ---
ASersp_plt <- ggplot(data = corASersp_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="ERSP (dB)",
                       limits = c(-0.8,0.8)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,10,20,30,40,50,60,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.text = element_text(size=5),
    axis.title = element_text(size=6),
    plot.title = element_text(size=6),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',color = NULL),
    legend.key.height = unit(4,'mm'),
    legend.key.width = unit(5,'mm'),
    legend.title = element_text(size=7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1.75, 1.5, 1.5, unit='mm'),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                   color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    plot.tag = element_text(size=6,face='bold'),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6)
  )

VGSersp_plt <- ggplot(data = VGSersp_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="ERSP (dB)",
                       limits = c(-0.8,0.8)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,10,20,30,40,50,60,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  paper_theme +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=5),
    axis.title = element_text(size=6),
    plot.title = element_text(size=6),
    plot.margin = margin(0.5, 1.75, 1.5, 1.5, unit='mm'))

# save legend
ersp_legend <- get_legend(ASersp_plt)
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"ersp_legend.png"), ersp_legend, width  = 15, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')

# save AS and VGS ersp plots together
AS <- ASersp_plt + theme(legend.position = 'none',
                         axis.title.x = element_blank())
VGS <- VGSersp_plt + theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1.75, 1.5, 1.5, unit='mm'))
aligned_plts <- align_plots(plotlist = list(AS, VGS),
                            align = 'v', axis = 'l')
plot_grid(aligned_plts[[1]],
          aligned_plts[[2]],
          nrow = 2
          )
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"ersp_frow.png"), height = 60, width = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')

# load in TFCE stats (t-values, enhanced t-values and masks)
clusterstats <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/Cluster_stats/corASvsVGS_ersp_prep_avgtrl_frow.mat")
clustermasks <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/Cluster_stats/corASvsVGS_tfceresults_ersp_prep_avgtrl_frow.mat")

# unlist variables
t_age <- clusterstats[["tval"]][[2]]
t_condition <- clusterstats[["tval"]][[3]]
t_interaction <- clusterstats[["tval"]][[4]]
mask_interaction <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[3]][[3]]
mask_age <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[1]][[3]]
mask_condition <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[2]][[3]]
enhancedt_interaction <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[3]][[1]]
enhancedt_age <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[1]][[1]]
enhancedt_condition <- clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[2]][[1]]

# plot t-values and masks from tfce
# interaction
t_interaction_df <- melt(t_interaction)
colnames(t_interaction_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
t_interaction_df$time <- times[t_interaction_df$time_idx]
t_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[t_interaction_df$freq_idx]
mask_interaction_df <- melt(mask_interaction)
colnames(mask_interaction_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
mask_interaction_df$time <- times[mask_interaction_df$time_idx]
mask_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[mask_interaction_df$freq_idx]
mask_interaction_df$value <- as.factor(mask_interaction_df$value)
enhancedt_interaction_df <- melt(enhancedt_interaction)
colnames(enhancedt_interaction_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
enhancedt_interaction_df$time <- times[enhancedt_interaction_df$time_idx]
enhancedt_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[enhancedt_interaction_df$freq_idx]
null_interaction_df <- melt(clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[3]][[2]])
colnames(null_interaction_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
null_interaction_df$time <- times[null_interaction_df$time_idx]
null_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[null_interaction_df$freq_idx]

# age
t_age_df <- melt(t_age)
colnames(t_age_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
t_age_df$time <- times[t_age_df$time_idx]
t_age_df$freq <- freqs[t_age_df$freq_idx]
mask_age_df <- melt(mask_age)
colnames(mask_age_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
mask_age_df$time <- times[mask_age_df$time_idx]
mask_age_df$freq <- freqs[mask_age_df$freq_idx]
mask_age_df$value <- as.factor(mask_age_df$value)
enhancedt_age_df <- melt(enhancedt_age)
colnames(enhancedt_age_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
enhancedt_age_df$time <- times[enhancedt_age_df$time_idx]
enhancedt_age_df$freq <- freqs[enhancedt_age_df$freq_idx]
null_age_df <- melt(clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[1]][[2]])
colnames(null_age_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
null_age_df$time <- times[null_age_df$time_idx]
null_age_df$freq <- freqs[null_age_df$freq_idx]

# condition
t_condition_df <- melt(t_condition)
colnames(t_condition_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
t_condition_df$time <- times[t_condition_df$time_idx]
t_condition_df$freq <- freqs[t_condition_df$freq_idx]
mask_condition_df <- melt(mask_condition)
colnames(mask_condition_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
mask_condition_df$time <- times[mask_condition_df$time_idx]
mask_condition_df$freq <- freqs[mask_condition_df$freq_idx]
mask_condition_df$value <- as.factor(mask_condition_df$value)
enhancedt_condition_df <- melt(enhancedt_condition)
colnames(enhancedt_condition_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
enhancedt_condition_df$time <- times[enhancedt_condition_df$time_idx]
enhancedt_condition_df$freq <- freqs[enhancedt_condition_df$freq_idx]
null_condition_df <- melt(clustermasks[["tfce.results"]][[2]][[2]])
```

### t-values
```{r}
 
# --- Raw- t-values ---
age_tval_plt <- ggplot(data = t_age_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="t-value",
                       limits = c(-4,4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,35,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  age_theme
  

condition_tval_plt <- ggplot(data = t_condition_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="t-value",
                       limits = c(-4,4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,35,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  condition_theme

interaction_tval_plt <- ggplot(data = t_interaction_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="t-value",
                       limits = c(-4,4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,35,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  interaction_theme
  
# save legend
tval_legend <- get_legend(interaction_tval_plt)
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"tval_legend.png"),tval_legend, width = 15, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')

age <- age_tval_plt + theme(legend.position = 'none',
                            axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Inverse age")

condition <- condition_tval_plt  + theme(legend.position = 'none',
                            axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                            axis.text.y=element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Condition")

interaction <- interaction_tval_plt  + theme(legend.position = 'none',
                            axis.title = element_blank(),
                            axis.text.y = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Interaction")

aligned_plts <- align_plots(
  plotlist = list(age,condition,interaction),
  align = 'h', axis = 'tb'
)
plot_grid(aligned_plts[[1]],
          aligned_plts[[2]],
          aligned_plts[[3]],
          nrow=1, 
          rel_widths = c(1.3,1,1))
ggsave(file.path(savedir, "tval_frow_heatmap.png"), width = 65, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')
```

### Null distributions
```{r}
# --- Null distributions ---
age_null_thres <- quantile(null_age_df$value, c(0.99))
age_null_plt <- ggplot(data = null_age_df, aes(x=value))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = age_null_thres, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 'dashed',color='red')+
  xlab("Enhanced t-value")+
  ylab("Count")+
  age_theme

condition_null_thres <- quantile(null_condition_df$value, c(0.99))
condition_null_plt <- ggplot(data = null_condition_df, aes(x=value))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = condition_null_thres, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 'dashed',color='red')+
  xlab("Enhanced t-value")+
  ylab("Count")+
  condition_theme

interaction_null_thres <- quantile(null_interaction_df$value, c(0.99))
interaction_null_plt <- ggplot(data = null_interaction_df, aes(x=value))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = interaction_null_thres, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 'dashed',color='red')+
  xlab("Enhanced t-value")+
  ylab("Count")+
  interaction_theme

age <- age_null_plt + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Inverse Age")
condition <- condition_null_plt + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Condition")
interaction <- interaction_null_plt + theme(axis.title = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Interaction")
aligned_plts <- align_plots(plotlist = list(age, condition, interaction),
                            align = 'h', axis='tb')
plot_grid(aligned_plts[[1]],
          aligned_plts[[2]],
          aligned_plts[[3]],
          nrow=1,
          rel_widths = c(1.1,1,1))
ggsave(file.path(savedir, "null_dist.png"), width = 65, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')
```
